interview_follow_up.title: Follow up after an interview
interview_follow_up.subject: Thank you — {role} conversation
body: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me about the {role} role.
I especially enjoyed our discussion about building reliable, human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
I'm excited about the opportunity and happy to share anything else that would be helpful.

project_update.title: Project status update
project_update.subject: Project Moonbeam — weekly update
body: Here is this week's update on Project Moonbeam.
We completed the workflow-graph milestone and the approval checkpoints are now in testing.
Next week we will focus on analytics and documentation.

meeting_request.title: Request a meeting
meeting_request.subject: Could we find 30 minutes next week?
body: I'd love to find 30 minutes next week to align on priorities.
Tuesday or Thursday afternoon would work well on my side.
Please let me know what suits you best.

thank_you.title: Say thank you
thank_you.subject: Thank you!
body: I wanted to say a heartfelt thank you for your support this month.
Your guidance made a real difference to how the launch came together.

introduction.title: Introduce yourself
introduction.subject: Nice to meet you
body: I'm reaching out to introduce myself — I lead the AI workflow initiative on my team.
I'd value the chance to learn how your team approaches automation and governance.

warm.opener: I hope your week is going beautifully!
